question: 把所有菇类都会吃两份会摄入多少大卡？

steps.description: Locate the grilled oyster mushroom (烤平菇) in the image and read the calorie value next to it
Locate the grilled shiitake mushroom (烤香菇) in the image and read the calorie value next to it
Locate the grilled enoki mushroom (烤金针菇) in the image and read the calorie value next to it
Multiply the calorie value from step_1 by 2 to get the calories for two servings of grilled oyster mushroom
Multiply the calorie value from step_2 by 2 to get the calories for two servings of grilled shiitake mushroom
Multiply the calorie value from step_3 by 2 to get the calories for two servings of grilled enoki mushroom
Sum the calorie values from steps 4, 5, and 6 to get the total calories for two servings of all mushroom types
